rule: Generation recipes never become geometry authority. Exact tuning values are experimental until benchmarked against source-preservation fixtures.

source_contract.guide_input: structure-only derived guide may suppress text/dimensions/hatches
source_contract.final_overlay: authoritative/source linework reapplied after generative passes

parameter_policy.note: Official ComfyUI guidance treats ControlNet strength/start/end as tuning controls; community architecture workflows report geometry drift even with ControlNet. Second-pass denoise behavior differs between latent upscale and image-space upscale.

safer_variants.preferred_for: texture exploration only after preservation benchmark
safer_variants.risk: second sampler may materially change geometry; denoise must be tuned by model and upscale method

rejection_rules: negative prompt is not a geometry guarantee
ControlNet is not a CAD accuracy guarantee
do not discard the original full drawing after creating a structure guide
do not promote AI or raster-derived geometry to authoritative geometry
do not use style score alone as completion evidence
